error.description: The OAuth/OpenID Connect error code, for example invalid_request.

errorDescription.description: A short explanation safe to show users.

LoginRequest.description: The sign-in form posted by the WebClient's Astro login page (application/x-www-form-urlencoded).

authRequest.description: The pending authorization request (the URL the server sent the browser to sign in for).

login.description: The login of the user trying to sign in.

password.description: The password of the user trying to sign in.

info.description: OpenID Connect provider for Cpnucleo: authorization code with PKCE, client credentials, refresh token rotation, revocation and end session.
info.title: Cpnucleo Identity API

parameters.description: The error id the server appended when it redirected to the sign-in page.
parameters.name: errorId

post.description: Form post from the WebClient sign-in page. Redirects to the authorization request on success, or back to the sign-in page with an error code.
post.summary: Sign in for a pending authorization request

get.description: The OpenID Connect login URL. Redirects to {origin}/login/?authRequest=... for the configured WebClient origin of the pending authorization request.

parameters.description: The pending authorization request the server wants the user to sign in for.
parameters.name: authRequest

get.summary: Send the browser to the WebClient sign-in page

get.description: Reached through the OpenID Connect end-session endpoint. Ends the session and redirects to the post-logout URL.

parameters.description: The logout context created by the end-session endpoint.
parameters.name: logoutId

get.summary: Sign out of the identity session

tags.description: Sign-in and sign-out steps of the OpenID Connect flows. Protocol endpoints are listed in /.well-known/openid-configuration.
tags.name: Account
